title: NordPulse Portable Blender for Smoothies, 16 oz Tritan Cup, Six-Blade Stainless Assembly, USB-C Rechargeable Base, Travel Bottle for Gym and Office Use
item_highlights: Tritan cup, six-blade stainless assembly, USB-C rechargeable base, one-press pulse control, travel bottle for the gym
short_description: NordPulse portable blender mixes smoothies and protein shakes in a 16 oz Tritan cup. Six-blade stainless assembly and rechargeable base fit in a bag. Fill to the marked line, lock the lid, and press the button once to start. Add liquid first, then fruit, then ice. The cup and blades rinse under the tap, and the lid and seal come off for a deeper wash. The base charges through a USB-C port and shows a small LED ring. Store with the cup open and the blade dry. Read the label before first use.
description: NordPulse portable blender with a 16 oz Tritan cup and a six-blade stainless assembly. Use it for smoothies, protein shakes, and soft fruit purees.
